decisions.executionNote: Begin left-tube approach with a gradual elbow-up lift and downward wrist rotation; geometry estimated from head view.
Advance the left arm toward the left tube, progressively pitching down and aligning the grasp with its visible axis.
Complete top-down alignment above the left tube, stopping short of final grasp depth for visual correction.
Use wrist view to center the tube between the fingers and descend cautiously to grasp height.
Finish wrist centering, close on the first tube and begin a minimal test lift.
Lift the first tube clear while retreating slightly; keep the grip closed and verify retention visually.
Transport the retained first tube toward the left rack slot while gradually rotating it upright.
Continue the upright rotation and approach the left-front rack opening, maintaining the closed grasp.
Finish upright orientation and hover over the selected left-front opening before insertion.
Align the upright first tube over the left-front large hole and lower toward the rack with a closed grip.
Lower the first tube vertically to seating depth, maintaining upright orientation and a closed grasp.
Release the seated first tube and retract upward and backward without disturbing the rack.
The first tube stands released in its slot. Retract the left arm while beginning an elbow-up approach to the far-right tube.
Advance the right arm toward the second tube with gradual downward pitch; continue the left arm's return clear of the rack.
Finish the left return and align the right gripper above the far-right tube, stopping above contact for wrist-view correction.
Use the right wrist view to advance along the tube and refine its axis alignment while descending to grasp height.
Center the second tube in the right fingers, close the gripper, and start a small retention-check lift.
Lift the second tube clear of the tabletop with the grip kept closed, checking retention in the wrist view.
Transport the retained second tube inward within the right workspace and gradually rotate it upright.
Continue the second tube's upright rotation and move toward the right rack opening, maintaining clearance.
Finish rotating the second tube upright and position it above the right-front rack slot.
Refine the second tube's alignment with the right-front opening while lowering halfway for a closer visual check.
Lower the upright second tube into the selected right slot with a small lateral refinement and the gripper closed.
The tube appears to have contacted the rim and slipped in the grasp. Lift clear and correct toward the right-front hole before retrying.
Retry a slow vertical insertion at the corrected right-slot alignment, monitoring for further sliding.
Complete the short seating descent, open the right gripper, and withdraw slightly to inspect whether the tube settles in the slot.
The second tube tipped after release rather than staying upright. Withdraw the open gripper to expose its resting position for recovery.
The second tube is lodged but leaning in the right opening. Approach its upper body with the open gripper for a controlled straightening recovery.
Lower slightly and pinch the leaning tube near its cap, then make a small lift to check the recovery grasp.
Lift the recovered tube fully clear of the rack before correcting its lean.
Rotate the recovered tube away from its visible lean, compensating upward to keep the tip clear.
Translate the straightened tube over the right large opening and begin a cautious descent using the recovered grasp.
Lower the corrected tube tip toward the large right opening with a minor leftward alignment adjustment.
Continue a slow straight descent of the recovered tube, checking that it enters rather than riding on the rim.
The tip is riding ahead of the large opening. Lift clear, then shift rearward toward its center rather than continuing to press downward.
The large opening is now beneath the tip in the wrist view. Lower vertically with the recovered grasp held closed.
Back off from possible rim contact and make a small forward-right correction to the right-front opening.
Lower through the opening now centered under the recovered tube tip, keeping the grasp closed.
The recovered tube is entering the large opening without visible sliding. Continue the short seating descent.
The tube appears inside the large opening. Open to let it settle freely and retract for an unobstructed upright check.
Two tubes now stand released in the rack. Move clear and rotate the right gripper toward the final tube's diagonal axis.
Approach the final tube from above, aligning the open gripper with its diagonal tabletop axis.
Finish the final tube's top-down alignment and descend to grasp height using the wrist image.
Shift the open grasp down the final tube's body, away from its cap, and refine centering before closing.
Close around the centered final tube, then lift gently to verify retention.
Lift the retained final tube clear and start its upright rotation with ample rack clearance.
Continue rotating the final tube upright while approaching the vacant middle opening from the right workspace.
Finish the final tube's upright rotation and hover above the vacant middle slot.
Align the final tube with the vacant middle opening and lower toward its rim while preserving the upright grasp.
Lower the final tube into the middle opening with a small leftward alignment correction.
